what: Why the subcortical regions look unusual
title: Shen 268 Subcortical Parcellation — shen268_subcortical
text: Shen 268 functional parcellation derived resting-state fMRI connectivity, anatomical one. Parcel boundaries follow connectivity gradients rather named anatomical structures, subcortical parcels correspond one--one structures like thalamus, caudate, putamen, left/right counts symmetric. 268 parcels, 15 fall subcortical territory centroid criterion (|x| < 25 mm, -20 < z < 20 mm, -30 < y < 15 mm MNI). greyscale anatomical context behind regions comes FreeSurfer's cvs_avg35_inMNI152 aparc+aseg, used purely visual backdrop. Shen volume co-registered template (12-DOF affine) resampled 1 mm per-label trilinear interpolation + argmax keep boundaries smooth.

title: ggsegShen 1.0.3
text: subcortical atlas now uses bounding-box-framed slabs (3 coronal + 4 axial) structure dilation, 15 parcels read filled shapes inside grey brain across 7 views instead sparse slivers 3 views. subcortical cerebellar atlases now use evenly-spaced, distinct hues, individual parcels distinguishable (raw Shen LUT near-flat green/magenta per-hemisphere gradient). subcortical rebuild requires FreeSurfer 7.4.1. Replaced brittle subcortical/cerebellar vdiffr snapshots structural assertions.

title: ggsegShen 1.0.2
text: Atlas 2D geometry migrated sf-optional brain_polygons format (ggseg.formats 0.0.3). atlases now render without sf GDAL/GEOS/PROJ system libraries, enabling wasm air-gapped installs. Plots unchanged.
